title: Workers Strike at Major Mexican Silver-Lead Mine, Halting Output
content: Workers at a major silver-lead mine in Zacatecas state, Mexico, began an indefinite strike on Monday over wage disputes, halting production at a facility that accounts for roughly 3% of national silver output. The mine's operator said talks with the union have stalled and gave no timeline for a resolution. Mexico is the world's largest silver-producing country, and analysts flagged the stoppage as a potential near-term supply risk if it drags on.
